38866-the-evolution-of-photography-with-.title: The Evolution Of Photography With A Chronological Record Of
38866-the-evolution-of-photography-with-.creator: John Werge.
38866-the-evolution-of-photography-with-.description: A book by John Werge.. No previous history of photography, that I am aware of, has ever assumed the form of a reminiscence, nor have I met with a photographic work, of any description, that is so strictly built upon a chronological foundation as the one now placed in the hands of the reader. I therefore think, and trust, that it will prove to be an acceptable and readable addition to photographic literature.

This is the key-note of THE FLY LEAF, and Mr. Harte will be apt to say some trenchant, candid and always interesting things in its pages.--THE UNION AND ADVERTISER, Rochester, N.

arxiv-1610-06184.title: A new asteroseismic diagnostic for internal rotation in γ \gamma Doradus stars 2016 A new asteroseismic diagnostic for internal rotation in γ \gamma Doradus stars – 14
arxiv-1610-06184.creator: Rhita-Maria Ouazzani, S.J.A.J. Salmon, V. Antoci, T.R. Bedding, S.J. Murphy, I.W. Roxburgh
arxiv-1610-06184.description: Abstract With four years of nearly-continuous photometry from Kepler, we are finally in a good position to apply asteroseismology to γ \gamma Doradus stars. In particular several analyses have demonstrated the possibility to detect non-uniform period spacings, which have been predicted to be directly related to rotation.

arxiv-1907-09775.title: Multisensory Learning Framework for Robot Drumming
arxiv-1907-09775.creator: Andrey Barsky*, Claudio Zito*, Hiroki Mori**, Tetsuya Ogata**, Jeremy L. Wyatt*
arxiv-1907-09775.description: Abstract The hype about sensorimotor learning is currently reaching high fever, thanks to the latest advancement in deep learning. In this paper, we present an open-source framework for collecting large-scale, time-synchronised synthetic data from highly disparate sensory modalities, such as audio, video, and proprioception, for learning robot manipulation tasks.

arxiv-2101-01448.title: Four-Dimensional Imaging of Lattice Dynamics using Inelastic Scattering
arxiv-2101-01448.creator: Navdeep Rana 1, Aditya Prasad Roy 2, Dipanshu Bansal 2, Gopal Dixit 1
arxiv-2101-01448.description: Abstract Time-resolved mapping of lattice dynamics in real- and momentum-space is essential to understand better several ubiquitous phenomena such as heat transport, displacive phase transition, thermal conductivity, and many more. In this regard, time-resolved diffraction and microscopy methods are employed to image the induced lattice dynamics within a pump-probe configuration.

arxiv-2102-03953.title: Inscribed triangles of Jordan curves in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n}
arxiv-2102-03953.creator: Aryaman Gupta, Simon Rubinstein-Salzedo
arxiv-2102-03953.description: Abstract . Nielsen’s theorem states that any triangle can be inscribed in a planar Jordan curve. We prove a generalisation of this theorem, extending to any Jordan curve J J embedded in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} , for a restricted set of triangles.

arxiv-2205-00673.title: Microscopic theory of thermalization in 1D with nonlinear bath coupling
arxiv-2205-00673.creator: A. Rodin, B. A. Olsen, M. Choi, A. Tan
arxiv-2205-00673.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. Rodin, B. A. Olsen, M. Choi, A. Tan. Using a non-perturbative classical model, we numerically investigate the dynamics of mobile particles interacting with an infinite chain of harmonic oscillators, an abstraction of ionic conduction through solid-state materials. We show that coupling between the mobile particles and a single mass of the chain is sufficient to induce dissipation of the mobile particles’ energy over a wide range of system parameters.

arxiv-2404-06089.title: EVE: Enabling Anyone to Train Robots using Augmented Reality Thanks: ∗ Equal Contribution.
arxiv-2404-06089.creator: Jun Wang, Chun-Cheng Chang ∗, Jiafei Duan ∗, Dieter Fox, Ranjay Krishna
arxiv-2404-06089.description: Abstract . The increasing affordability of robot hardware is accelerating the integration of robots into everyday activities. However, training a robot to automate a task requires expensive trajectory data where a trained human annotator moves a physical robot to train it. Consequently, only those with access to robots produce demonstrations to train robots.

arxiv-2405-02259.title: Spatiotemporal spectral transfers in fluid dynamics
arxiv-2405-02259.creator: Avik Mondal, Andrew J. Morten, Brian K. Arbic, Glenn R. Flierl, Robert B. Scott, Joseph Skitka
arxiv-2405-02259.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Avik Mondal, Andrew J. Morten, Brian K. Arbic, Glenn R. Flierl, Robert B. Scott, Joseph Skitka. Motivated by previous work on kinetic energy cascades in the ocean, atmosphere, plasmas, and other fluids, we develop a spatiotemporal spectral transfer tool that can be used to study scales of variability in generalized dynamical systems.

arxiv-2406-02021.title: FFNet: MetaMixer-based Efficient Convolutional Mixer Design
arxiv-2406-02021.creator: Seokju YunDongheon Lee, Youngmin RoMachine Intelligence Laboratory, University of Seoul, Korea {wsz871, dslisleedh, youngmin.ro}@uos.ac.kr https://github.com/ysj9909/FFNet
arxiv-2406-02021.description: Abstract 1 1 footnotetext: Corresponding author. Transformer, composed of self-attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN), has revolutionized the landscape of network design across various vision tasks. While self-attention is extensively explored as a key factor in performance, FFN has received little attention. FFN is a versatile operator seamlessly integrated into nearly all AI models to effectively harness rich representations.

arxiv-2412-18425.title: Computing the k k -binomial complexity of generalized Thue–Morse words
arxiv-2412-18425.creator: M. Golafshan, M. Rigo, M. A. Whiteland
arxiv-2412-18425.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. Golafshan, M. Rigo, M. A. Whiteland. Two finite words are k k -binomially equivalent if each subword (i.e., subsequence) of length at most k k occurs the same number of times in both words. The k k -binomial complexity of an infinite word is a function that maps the integer n ⩾ 0 n\geqslant 0 to the number of k k -binomial equivalence classes represented by its factors of length n n .

arxiv-2502-07294.title: Estimating the Mass Escaping Rates of Radius-valley-spanning Planets in the TOI-431 System via X-Ray and Ultraviolet Evaporation
arxiv-2502-07294.creator: Xiaoming Jiang(蒋效铭), Jonathan H. Jiang, Remo Burn, Zong-Hong Zhu
arxiv-2502-07294.description: Abstract TOI-431 system has 3 close-in exoplanets, which gives an ideal lab to study gas escape. In this study, we measure the XUV luminosity for TOI-431 with XMM-Newton/EPIC-pn and OM data, then calculate the fluxes for the planets in the system.

arxiv-2512-19250.title: Small Language Models as Compiler Experts: Auto-Parallelization for Heterogeneous Systems
arxiv-2512-19250.creator: Prathamesh Devadiga
arxiv-2512-19250.description: Abstract Traditional auto-parallelizing compilers, reliant on rigid heuristics, struggle with the complexity of modern heterogeneous systems. This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of small ( 1B parameter) Language Model (LLM)-driven compiler auto-parallelization. We evaluate three models— gemma3 , llama3.2 , and qwen2.5 —using six reasoning strategies across 11 real-world kernels from scientific computing, graph algorithms, and machine learning.

arxiv-2602-17836.title: Nonlinear dynamics of a vertical pendulum driven by magnetic field provided by two coils magnets: analytical, numerical and experimental studies Journal: Nonlinear Dynamics
arxiv-2602-17836.creator: B. Nana a∗, K. Polczyński b, P. Woafo c and J. Awrejcewicz b
arxiv-2602-17836.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by B. Nana a∗, K. Polczyński b, P. Woafo c and J. Awrejcewicz b. In the present work, we analyzed theoretically and experimentally the nonlinear dynamics of a magnetic pendulum excited through the interactions of a strong neodymium magnet and two coils placed symmetrically around the zero angular position. The forces between the magnet and coils and generated torques acting on the pendulum are derived using the magnetic charges interaction model and an experimentally fitted model.

The word in its original form is now obsolete. It derives from the Mid. cirurgien or sirurgien, through the Fr. χειρουργός , one who operates with the hand (from χεἰρ , hand, ἔργον , work); from the early form is derived the modern word “surgeon.” “Chirurgeon” is a 16th century reversion to the Greek origin.

pmc-10765003.title: 2023 Korean Endocrine Society Consensus Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Primary Aldosteronism
pmc-10765003.creator: Jeonghoon Ha, Jung Hwan Park, Kyoung Jin Kim, Jung Hee Kim, Kyong Yeun Jung, Jeongmin Lee, Jong Han Choi, Seung Hun Lee, Namki Hong, Jung Soo Lim, Byung Kwan Park, Jung-Han Kim, Kyeong Cheon Jung, Jooyoung Cho, Mi-kyung Kim, Choon Hee Chung, The Committee of Clinical Practice Guideline of Korean End
pmc-10765003.description: Primary aldosteronism (PA) is a common, yet underdiagnosed cause of secondary hypertension. It is characterized by an overproduction of aldosterone, leading to hypertension and/or hypokalemia. Despite affecting between 5.9% and 34% of patients with hypertension, PA is frequently missed due to a lack of clinical awareness and systematic screening, which can result in significant cardiovascular complications.

pmc-11488190.title: Rationale and Design of a Multi-National Study of Physicians’ Opinions, Attitudes, and Practices Regarding Influenza Vaccination in Patients with Cardiovascular Diseases: A Mixed Methods Designs. The FLUence Project
pmc-11488190.creator: Sebastián Garcia-Zamora, Angela S Koh, Svetlana Stoica, Nariman Sepehrvand, Harish Ranjani, Salisu Ishaku, Naomi Herz, Vanessa Kandoole-Kabwere, Pablo Perel, Amitava Banerjee, Charlotte Warren-Gash, Sean Taylor, Daniel José Piñeiro, María Inés Sosa-Liprandi, álvaro Sosa-Liprandi
pmc-11488190.description: Infections, particularly those involving the respiratory tract, are associated with an increased incidence of cardiovascular events, both de novo and as exacerbations of pre-existing cardiovascular diseases. Influenza vaccination has consistently been shown to reduce the incidence of cardiovascular events. Nonetheless, vaccination rates among adults remain suboptimal, both in the general population and among high-risk individuals.

pmc-11713348.title: Infections and cognitive function, depression, and frailty: a cross‐sectional study in the Longitudinal Aging Study in India (LASI)
pmc-11713348.creator: Georgia R Gore‐Langton, Kathryn E Mansfield, Prithvee Ravi, Arrisonia Doubatty, Suvarna Alladi, Sanjay Kinra, Charlotte Warren‐Gash
pmc-11713348.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSome infections may be associated with poor brain health, but evidence from low and middle‐income countries (LMICs) is limited. Therefore, we aimed to investigate associations between nine infections and cognitive function, depression, and frailty in India.MethodsWe conducted a cross‐sectional study using data from Wave 1 (2017‐2019) of the Longitudinal Aging Study in India (LASI) survey of adults (≥45years) from 35 of India’s 36 states and union territories. Survey data were collected via face‐to‐face interviews and direct health measurements.

pmc-12427994.title: Unraveling the Epigenetic Landscape of Mature B Cell Neoplasia: Mechanisms, Biomarkers, and Therapeutic Opportunities
pmc-12427994.creator: Nawar Maher, Francesca Maiellaro, Joseph Ghanej, Silvia Rasi, Riccardo Moia, Gianluca Gaidano, Grzegorz Przybylski, Albrecht Reichle
pmc-12427994.description: Epigenetic regulation is critical to B cell development, guiding gene expression via DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin remodeling, and noncoding RNAs. In mature B cell neoplasms, particularly diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL), follicular lymphoma (FL), and chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), these mechanisms are frequently disrupted.

pmc-12609026.title: Diagnosis of Secondary Bacterial Meningitis via Aromatic Metabolites and Biomarkers in Cerebrospinal Fluid
pmc-12609026.creator: Petr A Meinarovich, Ekaterina A Sorokina, Natalia V Beloborodova, Alisa K Pautova, Cheryl Anne Frye, Manuel Menéndez-González
pmc-12609026.description: The development of sensitive and specific diagnostic methods for secondary bacterial meningitis remains an urgent challenge in neurosurgical and intensive care units. A combination of various clinical and biochemical parameters, as well as biomarkers and metabolites in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), can be considered for constructing multivariate diagnostic models.

pmc-13100252.title: Assessing the causal effect of tobacco retail density on cardiovascular and pulmonary disease hospitalizations in the United States
pmc-13100252.creator: Chris D. Baggett, Tzy-Mey Kuo, Paul N. Zivich, Jacqueline E. Rudolph, Kurt M. Ribisl, Shelley D. Golden
pmc-13100252.description: ObjectivesHigh tobacco retail density is linked to greater tobacco-related disease, but most evidence is cross-sectional limiting causal inference. Here, we use longitudinal data (2002–2016) from 327 counties in five U.S. states to estimate the causal effect of reducing tobacco retail density on hospitalizations for cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases.

pmc-13401487.title: Dysregulated myelopoiesis and enhanced glutaminase-dependent neutrophil survival in preclinical obesity
pmc-13401487.creator: Madison Babcock, Aric Lechner, Julia Drolet, Lynn Agostini, Ruth Weinstock, Norifumi Urao
pmc-13401487.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obesity is increasingly recognized as a state of chronic low-grade inflammation associated with altered immune cell function, yet the mechanisms driving these changes remain incompletely understood. This study investigated myeloid cell subpopulations and neutrophil behavior in adult participants exhibiting preclinical obesity (body mass index [BMI] 32–51 kg/m2, n = 12) compared to normal-weight controls (BMI 21–24 kg/m2, n = 9), correlating findings with metabolic and inflammatory markers.

pmc-13539164.title: HvPHO1 Controls a Glucose 1‐Phosphate–SnRK1 Signalling Module That Coordinates Starch Accumulation in Barley Endosperm
pmc-13539164.creator: Yulong Li, Yujia Chen, Jing Liu, Ping Yang, Guangqi Gao, Carlos Guzmán, Qiang Xu, Yazhou Zhang, Yanlin Liu, Pengfei Qi, Mei Deng, Shoufen Dai, Jian Ma, Guoyue Chen, Jirui Wang, Youliang Zheng, Yuming Wei, Qiantao Jiang
pmc-13539164.description: Developing barley grains must balance the use of imported sucrose between soluble sugars and storage starch, but how this balance is controlled remains unclear. Here we show that loss of the plastidial α‐glucan phosphorylase HvPHO1 causes starch and soluble sugars to accumulate concurrently in barley grains.

pmc-13613994.title: Nursing Image Among Pre‐Nursing Students: A Mixed‐Methods Systematic Review with Future Directions on Recruitment Strategies
pmc-13613994.creator: Shin Syuen Lee, Joko Gunawan, Siriwan Lim, Ivan Rubbi, Vivien K. G. Lim, Sok Ying Liaw
pmc-13613994.description: AimTo synthesize existing evidence to inform targeted recruitment strategies and interventions.BackgroundThe ongoing global shortage of nurses presents a significant threat to healthcare delivery. Addressing this requires an understanding of why pre‐nursing students choose to or avoid nursing as a career. A key deterrent is the profession's negative image, often associated with “dirty work.
